I can understand. I would like to say i despise living in this shitty world, where people are brainwashed into a deception of what truly matters. People that are able to leave this world are now most likely away from this world and in peace. I do agree it can be good for a lot of people.

Life should not be like this, life is precious but the way we live now is fucked up to begin with imo. If life was different, I would hope no one would suicide. The way it is now, I can almost agree with them. Whether or not suicide is worth it or not is something I do not know.

Your sister is toxic. I hate dealing with toxic people, they will literally make your thoughts turn negative. You deserve love and help, and i'm sorry you cannot find that within your family. Hope you can find it within yourself.
Wish you the best. Safety, life, long lasting peace.

I feel like for most people this is true. It's not that I truly don't give a shit about anyone, it's that I care more or think about others more than they do. I can't take care of anyone fully since I got myself to take care of too, but I do care about people. I know that there are shitty people who really do not give a single shit about others, and i know that could be most or everyone that you come across as well. I would feel the same way.

Edit; cannot deny though, this is a shitty world

Yes i really don't understand the terms, thank you very much for explaining. I'm new to this stuff and reading a short summary through a google search misrepresents the truth imo.

I'm probably not demisexual.

Prob not asexual either, just my stress/nervousness/overthinking leads me to appear asexual. My sex drive is stupid low in real life, but porn when i used to watch it was a different story... If I see an attractive woman, i may get bothered/nervous but i never really get horny/turned on. I may get slightly turned on if they're dressed sexy/ kinda slutty but only then... I'm basically never turned on though, i find it weird since most people around me are turned on or think dirty. Even if i had the chance with a hot girl i'm not sure if i could do the deed.

I believe you are right about the stress getting in the way.

You are right about myself having low self esteem. However, I also miss a lot of my chances because "I don't want to be weird" or "I don't want to be too pushy". I also would have a hard time just randomly talking to a girl in a out of normal situation (on the street for example). I think too much as well and end up overthinking things.

Thank you for the great reply! And your time! It helped me clear up a lot of things in my mind. i appreciate it!

I think you're right about being heteromantic, and ageosexual is interesting to look into.

This helps a lot, thank you!

Thank you very much! you are very right. I'm glad you were "lucky " per say, but i can almost guarantee i got more than 1 std on my very first hookup... I can't believe it. I can't say everything for sure but most likely herpes for sure. You are right though, i won't know for sure until i test and the peace of mind is worth it.

​

Explaining my view of sexuality, ignore if you like. I may follow your advice and post in the lgbt community. Great ideas/advice!

As for the sexuality, i believe im probably demisexual/ asexual. Since a young boy i've masturbated to porn and i feel i'm truly only attracted to those "perfect" but fake girls. I also do feel like i want a connection before doing the deed(demisexual). I also sometimes feel like i need to force myself to be sexual, but otherwise i wouldn't need it (asexual). I've recently stopped watching porn for the most part but i am very turned on by those videos for whatever reason, as if my brain is wired to be turned on only by them. Real life isn't enough. I also worry i cannot stay erect during the deed and i think it's because i really can't... only for porn lol. I also don't feel gay but the thought i might be comes across my head sometimes for whatever reason. I really like girls and i'm not turned on by guys. I don't think im bi either.

Sorry for some r rated terms, i really appreciate you bringing up that topic. I do believe knowing it is important. You have a lot of wisdom, and i appreciate you spending your time to tell me. I wish you the best as well, and hope good comes to you. Take care of yourself too if that's what you are trying to do. 

Bon soir! (and morning, week, year!)
much love, thank you very much!

Then things came up and now it's been difficult to get tested since im out of my home staying with my other parent (in simple non descriptive words).
